research_scope: Source-free mathematically type-aware prerequisite review; no original source edits, broad population or human certification.

aliases.reason: Finite positive-weight orthogonality Σ_{x∈X}p_n(x)p_m(x)w_x=0 uses the same discrete weighted inner-product equation as countably infinite support. In the finite case convergence is automatic; infinite support and moment assumptions are parent-specific.

Intermediate subfield k⊆L⊆K is an ordinary subfield L of K with inherited operations, together with the additional lower inclusion of k. This shares the subfield prerequisite in extension/prime-subfield sources, not the parent intermediate-field containment or algebraicity.

The coefficient-ring source uses pΛ, the principal ideal of Λ generated by the image of integer p. The general principal ideal (p) in a ring is exactly the same generated-ideal construction, while residue-characteristic and maximal-ideal intersection remain parent-specific.

The nonzero commutative unital ring R has associative commutative multiplication and a specified identity, exactly the general commutative unital ring prerequisite. Nonzeroness 0≠1 and field inversion, when present, remain parent-specific rather than imposed on all unital rings.
